title: 皐月賞の後に・師に捧げる栄冠

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Not yet… Not just yet… At the pace I'm running, the moment to strike is…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: NOW!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ignite! Burn, my competitive spirit! Become my strength!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Leading at the moment is Yaeno Muteki! Here she comes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A dance of flames.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: For an instant, her fighting spirit was as an inferno, flaring up high enough to incinerate the very sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Is that what she's keeping bottled up?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki has won the Satsuki Sho! The first race of the Classic Triple Crown is hers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (…Ah! Right, the winner's circle!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Holy moly! That was unbelievable! How can nobody know who she is when she's so good?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: You'll be at the Japanese Derby as well, right? I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (They're acknowledging my skill…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (All these people are acknowledging me!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stands erupt in unanimous applause in response to Yaeno Muteki's exclamation of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sob… Sob…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But only those who fight have the privilege of lamenting defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I do not even have that right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, I will shine bright at the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No matter how heavy the price I must pay.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm back.
choice_data_list: Congratulations on winning the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I couldn't have done it without your guidance. You have my heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A great number of people applauded me while I was standing in the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As I was showered in that thunderous applause, it became undeniably clear to me…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That the path I've been following was not a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, choosing to make use of my competitive spirit was definitely the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As was learning to temper my fierce blaze with the stillness of water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have undoubtedly chosen the right path. I would hope I've shown as much growth as I feel I have, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She used to be unable to control her competitive rage even in friendly competition. But now she can remain calm when the stakes are high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the principle of blaze fierce and water still, she's learned to analyze her surroundings and adapt in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that these things are undeniable proof of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then I must strive to better myself even further.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is up next. Please continue to lend me your strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We make it back to the academy, and just as we're about to part ways, a thought suddenly comes to me.
choice_data_list: Your grandparents must be very happy with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Who knows? They might not even know of my victory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No. They were unable to come because there was a class at the dojo at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't believe my ears. Unable to help myself, I remind her that she said her intent was to show her grandparents how much she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am but a fledgling who still needs to mature. The time to show them my running is still on the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As long as I keep winning, I'm sure the chance for them to watch will come.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In fact, I'm fine with them not coming to watch me until I've bested a good number of foes and conquered the entire Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From the looks of it, she probably won't even tell them about how she did today. That would be such a shame!
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll notify them of your results.
In that case, I'll notify them of your results.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And this is because reporting to my guardians is part of your duty as my trainer, I presume?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… Then, I can't stop you. It would pain me to see you rebuked for shirking your duty.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Feel free to call them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having received Yaeno Muteki's permission, I dial the number to her family's residence.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer. I hope that my granddaughter hasn't been causing you much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I summarize the circumstances leading up to the sudden phone call and explain that Yaeno Muteki has just won the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: …So it really happened.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: To be frank, I watched the race on TV during my break, but the reality still hasn't sunk in…
choice_data_list: It is reality, though! She really did win!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! So it's true after all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: That she was even able to compete in the Satsuki Sho is already a great honor in itself… But this… this is like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Despite this victory, she still has a long way to go. Her battle is not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: As always, I entrust Yaeno to your care. I wish you both a warrior's luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After receiving congratulations and words of appreciation from each and every one of Yaeno Muteki's family members, I hang up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, forgive me for what I said earlier.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't believe Grampa was that excited… and that he actually watched me…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Hehe, hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall use all of those words of encouragement as motivation to achieve victory at the Japanese Derby!
